sourceRootCategories: Category:Basketball coaches in Bosnia and Herzegovina by team

biography.introduction: Josip Pandža (born 14 May 1987) is a Bosnian basketball coach and former player. He is best known for leading the Bosnia and Herzegovina national under-16 team to the gold medal at the 2015 FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship, one of the most significant achievements in the history of the country’s basketball. He has coached several clubs in Bosnia and Herzegovina and abroad, including former EuroLeague winners KK Bosna Royal.
